correctness.rationale: For each modulus q>=2, the explicit valuation code over Z_2 has exactly one point over every noninteger and exactly q possible exceptional-symbol points over each embedded integer; distinct odometer parameters are separated by coordinates whose valuations differ by one. Since fibres are forward asymptotic, any equicontinuous factor identifies them, proving maximality of the Z_2 adding-machine factor. An arbitrary onto shift-equivariant map induces a Z_2 translation a, which must be an ordinary integer because an r-point target fibre cannot be the image of a nonsingular singleton source fibre. A source singular fibre with exponent residues fixed modulo q maps continuously only when those residues are fixed modulo r: precisely r divides q. If r divides q, coordinatewise reduction is onto; density of nonsingular fibres forces uniqueness of every factor as shift-power composed with reduction. The Python checker reproduced the substitution valuation identity and finite congruence models for q,r<=12, without extrapolating from finite samples.

originality.rationale: The evaluated novelty is the complete, uniform factor-preorder and all-map classification between the classical generalized period-doubling shifts. Bognini–Ammar introduce the q-letter sequences but their kernel-word factorization is a different combinatorial use of “factorization.” Gómez–Petite treat Toeplitz centralizers/normalizers and broad semicocycle constructions; a self-automorphism theorem does not imply that a surjection between unequal moduli must be coordinate reduction with r|q. Sell–Sieron prove structural inheritance for boundaries under factors, not the exact q-to-r arithmetic characterization. Sell’s simple-Toeplitz complexity and repetitivity theorems do not state the morphism classification. Related indexed results about modular gap shifts and a three-block period-doubling skew product concern different systems. Historical priority under different factor-language terminology is a residual risk.

value.rationale: An all-parameter complete classification of continuous topological factor maps for an infinite classical, primitive zero-entropy substitution family is a natural dynamical classification question. It gives the exact factor preorder (divisibility), proves the surprising absence of all nontrivial higher-radius factor maps, and shows that sharing the same maximal equicontinuous odometer does not imply mutual factoring. The mathematical distinction is an exact singular-fibre residue obstruction, rather than a routine symbolic relabelling or tiny finite cutoff.
